description:
Singer-songwriter Stephen Wilson Jr. talks about the people who inspired his new single, "Hardwired"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Stephen Wilson Jr. considers the influences that went into his new single, “Hardwired” — like country artists George Jones, Johnny Cash and Tim McGraw. But perhaps most important of all are the hardworking people Wilson Jr. writes about in the song. “I'm really just trying to celebrate and kind of perhaps shine a flashlight on those characters of our society that kind of get under-celebrated,” he says.

Stephen Wilson Jr. was Zach McCormick's guest on The Current's July 31, 2026, episode of Tonal Recall, the show that celebrates the music and culture of the 1990s. Find the full interview with Stephen Wilson Jr. here: https://youtu.be/5VhaMOoMaDs
